name: Hearts on Fire
source:
When a charming firefighter saves your life, you decide it's time for a career change... But who knew your savior would end up being your boss?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Hearts_on_Fire]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当一位迷人的消防员救了你的命时，你决定是时候改变职业了……但谁知道你的救世主最终会成为你的老板？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Hearts_on_Fire]Choices Wikia[/url]]
